## Project Overview

This is a TypeScript / React project.

**Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript
**Frameworks & Libraries:** React (19.1.0), Tailwind CSS
**Package Manager:** npm

## Coding Conventions

- TypeScript — strong typing throughout
- Path aliases configured in tsconfig.json
- File naming: PascalCase for components

## React Guidelines

- Use functional components with hooks
- Prefer composition over inheritance
- Keep components focused on a single responsibility

## Styling

- Use **Tailwind CSS** utility classes for styling
- Avoid custom CSS unless absolutely necessary
- Use Tailwind config for theme customization

## Code Generation Preferences

- Follow the existing patterns in this codebase
- Prefer readability over brevity
- Include error handling in generated code
- Always include TypeScript types; do not use `any`
- Add JSDoc comments to exported functions
